cs.t: I have a small two-room apartment and have a little office space set up at the foot of my bed, near the window. Usually I work from here, but sometimes if I feel like variety I work from my "kitchen" table in the living room, on the couch. I work from a laptop (MBP and ThinkPad P14s). I just use the built-in webcams. Work desk: Matting StandUp desk. I like it because it is manual and doesn't require cables. Chair: Varier Variable Balans. Nice to sit in weird positions and fidget on as much as I like.
